sentences.text: Health visitor Rachel Moore confirmed the visit is Noah's four-month check.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported that her son Noah is on formula, five ounces every three to four hours.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported she stopped breastfeeding at six weeks.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported Noah produces six to seven wet nappies a day.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported Noah sleeps for a five-hour stretch from about 11:00 until 4:00.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported Noah sleeps in a Moses basket in her room, which is getting too small.
Health visitor Rachel Moore reported Noah weighs 6.8 kilos.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported her daughter Isla loves reception class.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported Isla's teacher is Miss Patel.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported she is not feeling well.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported she has not been sleeping since Sunday.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported her daughter Isla said Uncle Ryan touched her private parts (front bottom) when he babysits.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported Isla said Ryan told her it is a secret and not to tell mummy.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported Isla told her about Ryan on Sunday night while in the bath.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported Ryan is Liam's brother and babysits on Fridays when the mother is at work and Liam is on nights.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported Ryan has been babysitting since September.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported she told Liam about the disclosure.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported Liam is unsure whether to believe the disclosure.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported her sister Kelly said Ryan was in trouble years ago with the police.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported Kelly does not know what the trouble was and heard it from someone at her work.
Health visitor Rachel Moore reported Kelly does not know if the information about Ryan is true.
Health visitor Rachel Moore stated she must share the disclosure with children's social care (Harbridge MASH) today.
Health visitor Rachel Moore advised that Ryan must not babysit or have any time alone with Isla or Noah until the situation is looked into.
Health visitor Rachel Moore advised the mother not to confront Ryan herself.
Health visitor Rachel Moore advised the mother to ask Liam to wait before going to Ryan's house.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported she is managing financially okay.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported Liam works nights at a warehouse.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported she has money from the Co-op and child benefit.
Health visitor Rachel Moore stated she will ring the mother by 4:00 PM to tell her what Harbridge MASH said.
Health visitor Rachel Moore stated she will ring the mother to confirm actions regarding keeping the children away from Ryan and asking the mother's mum about Friday childcare.
